description: Agent cost and throughput parameters, low tier (Claude Sonnet 5 pricing). See paper/main.tex tab:scenario:agents. The capability parameters r_bugs and d_test derive from the vals.ai SWE-bench Verified scores (0.80/0.95/0.97 for low/medium/high): r_bugs = 1 - score, d_test = score - 0.2. c_token is indexed by agent role 1-8 and is a cost per unit of that role's throughput rate; roles 4-6 (Refactoring, Code Review, Security Audit) have no countable unit of output, so r_k = 1 and c_token is a flat fee per deployed instance per sprint. r_refactor is denominated in D_tech units, not in work items: one agent removes the debt that one feature or one bug fix adds, so it is calibrated against delta_impl / delta_fix and takes the same values by tier.
